guides.title: Notifications and preferences
guides.content_mode: Implemented bounded synthetic workflow; draft guidance

sections.title: Purpose and outcome
paragraphs: Use Inbox, Grouped changes, Owned escalations and Preferences to coordinate current permitted Activity work. A notice is a source event; reading it is not completing the Activity.

sections.title: Before you start
paragraphs: Sign in to the synthetic application. Only current permitted Activity events for your current ownership are projected; historical recipients are not inferred.

sections.title: Quick start
steps: Open the header notification bell or My Work > Updates & preferences.
Choose a view, inspect the source and open a notice for current details.
Mark read or unread explicitly; open the source Activity to complete the actual work.

sections.title: Understand this page
paragraphs: Inbox shows individual events. Grouped changes gathers notices by source. Owned escalations shows current open owned Activities even without a notice. Preferences records email category modes, digest cadence, timezone, quiet hours and grouping.

sections.title: Information you need
paragraphs: Each notice retains event identity/time and source version. Current text and access are resolved again when opened. Inbox is a bounded slice of 200 notices, with a visible limit; owned obligations are read independently.

sections.title: Complete the main task
steps: Use explicit read/unread or archive/restore for the displayed notices. Bulk actions carry the displayed IDs and versions.
Keep active owned work visible: archive is refused while the source obligation remains open.
Edit preferences and Save preferences. Read the saved/dirty/error state before leaving.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: Opening or reading a notice never changes source status. Source completion remains in the Activity workflow. Saved preferences persist but do not schedule or send email, push or SMS.

sections.title: Statuses, warnings and save state
paragraphs: Loading, empty, partial/unavailable, denied, stale and save-error states are distinct. An unavailable source is not a zero workload. A conflicting save requires refresh/review rather than silent overwrite.

sections.title: Worked example
paragraphs: A synthetic assigned follow-up can have several retained events. Marking an event read leaves the open Activity in Owned escalations until the source work is completed.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: Refresh after a source/access/version change. Review the source before retrying an archive refusal. Unsaved preferences use the existing navigation warning; refresh can discard the draft.

sections.title: Mobile, keyboard and offline use
paragraphs: At 390 and 320 CSS px, wrap filters and notice actions, stack preference fields and retain readable source labels. Use Tab and Escape with the native detail dialog and return focus to its opener. Offline notification writes are not supported.

sections.title: Related guidance and procedures
paragraphs: Source Activities own completion. See SH-03 evidence and the My Work handover; delivery-provider integration remains a separate dependency.

sections.title: Guide review and feedback
paragraphs: Draft for owner review against SH implementation. Functional evidence and historical captures do not grant guide approval or deployment acceptance.

guides.title: Search
guides.content_mode: Implemented bounded synthetic workflow; draft guidance

sections.title: Purpose and outcome
paragraphs: Find permitted records through the same source registry in global compact search and the full Search page. Preview context, then open the owning record.

sections.title: Before you start
paragraphs: Sign in with current source access. Search spans implemented CRM, Engineering packages, Activities, Service requests, facilities/growing areas and exact permitted issued job packs. It is not a universal document or Knowledge index.

sections.title: Quick start
steps: Enter at least two characters in global search, or open /search.
Choose View all results, then narrow by record type when more results are available.
Preview a result, inspect its company/site/source context and choose Open record.

sections.title: Understand this page
paragraphs: Compact search offers up to five items per type; full search offers twenty per type. Full results show source availability and source-specific next-page controls. Saved views retain supported criteria; the preview is a native dialog.

sections.title: Information you need
paragraphs: Use text and optional record type. Pagination requires one type and a cursor tied to the query. Facility context identifies site, physical parent and grouping; identical names alone do not establish identity.

sections.title: Complete the main task
steps: Enter text and inspect the available results and source-state message.
Choose a single type to page through additional results.
Create, rename, update, duplicate, pin or retire a personal saved view when useful.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: Open record hands off to the owning domain. Browser Back retains URL criteria. Search and preview do not grant permission or modify the source.

sections.title: Statuses, warnings and save state
paragraphs: Distinguish empty from partial, unavailable and denied. There is no global total across bounded source pages. A revoked/missing preview has no usable source link.

sections.title: Worked example
paragraphs: Two synthetic growing areas with the same name can have different sites and physical/grouping parents. Use the displayed context and source ID to choose the correct area.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: Retry unavailable sources, clear an invalid cursor by starting a fresh search, and refresh after access changes. Do not infer no records from a failed source.

sections.title: Mobile, keyboard and offline use
paragraphs: Filters, saved-view controls and results wrap at 390 and 320 CSS px. Preserve long labels and context, keyboard result selection, Escape and dialog focus return. Search requires a connection; no offline search index is supplied.

sections.title: Related guidance and procedures
paragraphs: See SH-04/SH-05 handover and verification. The source domain remains responsible for edits and current permission.

sections.title: Guide review and feedback
paragraphs: Draft for owner review against SH implementation. Functional evidence and historical captures do not grant guide approval or deployment acceptance.

guides.title: Personal saved views
guides.content_mode: Implemented bounded synthetic workflow; draft guidance

sections.title: Purpose and outcome
paragraphs: Reuse named personal criteria in supported workspaces. Existing My Work saved-view IDs/storage remain intact; new Search, Reviews and Updates targets use registered criteria schemas.

sections.title: Before you start
paragraphs: Sign in and select an eligible workspace. Team sharing requires a canonical team model which is absent; role, department and workspace membership are not substitutes.

sections.title: Quick start
steps: Set supported filters and choose Save view.
Name the view and save it to My views.
Choose a saved view to apply its criteria, then manage it if needed.

sections.title: Understand this page
paragraphs: Saved-view controls offer create/use, rename, update criteria, duplicate, pin and retire. The Team area explicitly reports Not configured.

sections.title: Information you need
paragraphs: Each target validates only its supported criteria and retains a version for conflict handling. A maximum of twelve personal views is supported per registered target.

sections.title: Complete the main task
steps: Save the current criteria under a recognisable personal name.
Use Update criteria to replace the saved criteria deliberately.
Duplicate for an alternative, pin for quick access or retire an obsolete personal view.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: Saving criteria does not modify source records, permission grants or another user’s views. A view name is not a shared team definition.

sections.title: Statuses, warnings and save state
paragraphs: Empty, invalid criteria, capacity reached, saving and version conflict remain visible. Review a refreshed version before retrying a stale write.

sections.title: Worked example
paragraphs: Save a personal Reviews view for Engineering returned work, then switch back to All permitted without changing the underlying source decisions.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: Refresh after a conflicting edit or identity change. Start a fresh view if its target criteria no longer apply. Canonical team ownership/membership is required before sharing can be implemented.

sections.title: Mobile, keyboard and offline use
paragraphs: Saved-view controls and the editor wrap at 390 and 320 CSS px. Retain labelled names, explicit update actions, Escape and focus return. Offline writes are not supported.

sections.title: Related guidance and procedures
paragraphs: See SH-05 handover, registered view targets and the explicit canonical-team dependency.

sections.title: Guide review and feedback
paragraphs: Draft for owner review against SH implementation. Functional evidence and historical captures do not grant guide approval or deployment acceptance.

guides.title: Reviews and handovers
guides.content_mode: Implemented bounded synthetic workflow; draft guidance

sections.title: Purpose and outcome
paragraphs: Coordinate current review work without creating another approval authority. My reviews, All permitted, Returned to me, Handovers, Sent by me and History use real source records.

sections.title: Before you start
paragraphs: Sign in with source read permission. Assignment, reviewer eligibility and author/receiver roles come from the source. The queue does not create a Finance reviewer assignment.

sections.title: Quick start
steps: Choose the perspective that matches your work.
Filter by source and owner, then inspect the current task detail.
Use Open source to review or correct the source record; return to refresh the queue.

sections.title: Understand this page
paragraphs: Six view controls, source/owner criteria, personal saved views and a paged worklist share the My Work shell. The detail dialog shows current status/version, ownership, submission/due facts and return reason where supplied.

sections.title: Information you need
paragraphs: A missing due date says Date needed. Source slices are explicitly bounded: Service 200, Finance 500 and Engineering 200 packages; queue pages show 30 rows. Counts describe the available slice, not all business work.

sections.title: Complete the main task
steps: Inspect current source version and requested work.
For Returned to me, follow the actual correction owner and due date; an old reviewer assignment is not a current review after return.
Open the source to approve, return, correct or receive using its existing authority checks.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: Only the source command records the business decision. The coordination queue re-resolves source access/version before opening and requires refresh after a stale result.

sections.title: Statuses, warnings and save state
paragraphs: All-source failure/denial does not show zero workload. A partial source slice remains qualified. History is distinct from current actionability, and missing owner/due facts are not invented.

sections.title: Worked example
paragraphs: An Engineering return appears as one correction for its named owner, rather than a second pending review. A returned handover follows the source correction owner, reason and due date.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: Refresh a stale task before reopening. If current access is revoked, return to a permitted queue. Retain the source failure message and retry; do not complete or approve from the coordination view.

sections.title: Mobile, keyboard and offline use
paragraphs: Wrap all six perspectives and filters, stack long source/owner details at 390 and 320 CSS px, and keep Open source and dialog close reachable. Keyboard focus returns on Escape. Review decisions require the online source workflow.

sections.title: Related guidance and procedures
paragraphs: Service reports, Finance handoffs and Engineering changes own their commands. See SH-06 implementation evidence and ADR-0041.

sections.title: Guide review and feedback
paragraphs: Draft for owner review against SH implementation. Functional evidence and historical captures do not grant guide approval or deployment acceptance.

sections.title: Before you start

sections.title: Quick start

Choose a view and inspect its source owner, as-at and completeness statement.
Open an exact source record to make the business decision there.

sections.title: Controls and views

sections.title: Records and source boundaries
paragraphs: Customer 360 is a projection. CRM, Estimating, Service, Projects and Finance keep their decisions. MYOB orders and a generic SharePoint document library are not connected; unavailable is not zero. Account currencies and alternative estimate populations are never totalled.

sections.title: Workflow
steps: Confirm the customer name, relationship owner and permitted source availability.
Choose a view and inspect its source owner, as-at and completeness statement.

sections.title: What completion means
paragraphs: A save is complete when the page confirms Saved to the server. A recorded review or acknowledgement remains bound to its exact source.
Local code delivery is separate from owner business acceptance and deployment.

sections.title: States and availability
paragraphs: Loading, unavailable, restricted and an empty permitted result have different meanings. Hidden records and counts are not disclosed.

sections.title: Worked example
paragraphs: A coordinator sees a permitted service case at a related Site, opens its exact case, then creates a customer-linked Activity. The Site relationship does not establish who pays the bill.

sections.title: Recovery and errors
paragraphs: Validation appears beside the relevant field and in the error summary. Correct the highlighted value and retry.
A stale version is refused. Retain your intended correction, reload the current record and reconcile it deliberately.
If the save outcome is uncertain, use Confirm original save; the original operation is retried without creating a second effect.
If permissions or source availability change, the page clears inaccessible content. Reopen the canonical source or ask its owner to resolve the context.

sections.title: Keyboard and smaller screens

Print preview opens the exact saved server preview. Browser Print instead produces a labelled workbench copy of the saved revision, even when Preparation is selected; unsaved entries are excluded. steps: Prepare the pack against the correct scope
Review exact source/template revisions and readiness
Issue the checked pack and track recipient acknowledgement

When sources have changed, choose Review changed sources. In Preparation, review the current source information and choose Refresh saved sources… to record a reason and save a successor, even when the nine notes are unchanged.

For a saved preparation preview, choose Print preview, then Print saved draft. Unsaved entries stay in the form. Choose Save and print… to record a reason and save first; after success, open Print saved revision to print that exact successor.
Open exact issued document opens the retained controlled issue. A preparation preview is not an issue and printing never acknowledges a pack.
Compare the structured details with Exact text as it will be issued when reviewing a saved section. Captured readiness belongs to that revision; use Pack readiness for current assessments.

guides.title: Estimating intake and workload
guides.content_mode: Native read workflow with explicit unavailable policy actions

sections.title: Purpose and outcome
paragraphs: Use the intake and workload view to find an opportunity brief, identify its current estimating owner and scope readiness, then open the exact discovery or saved estimate. This view reads canonical Sales and Estimating records; it does not accept intake, approve prices or issue a quotation.

sections.title: Before you start
paragraphs: Current estimating.read, CRM opportunity and underlying customer/site/contact access are required. Current discovery and cost sources are independently checked. A Sales owner is not automatically the estimating owner. Start discovery additionally needs estimating.edit; existing edit and ownership guards are rechecked in the wizard.

sections.title: Quick start
paragraphs: Open Estimating > Intake & workload. Search a customer, opportunity reference, title or brief. Expand Readiness, owner and sort for additional filters, then Apply filters. Collapsing the controls retains their selections. Review ownership and the selected discovery revision. Open discovery to resolve scope or deliberately adopt manual costs. Use Saved estimates for the existing exact-version workbook and Draft output.

sections.title: Understand this page
paragraphs: The page has a workload/saved-estimates navigation row, search/readiness/owner/sort filters and one card per permitted opportunity. Desktop cards align brief, ownership/source context and next estimating step. Phone cards stack these sections without hiding scope states or actions.

sections.title: Information you need
paragraphs: Customer and brief come from the linked Opportunity, with its readable reference, UUID and current source version. Estimating owner comes from the discovery workspace. Each saved estimate retains its own option and costed discovery revision. Required response date is Unknown: neither the Sales next-action date nor expected close date is substituted.

sections.title: Complete the main task
paragraphs: Use My estimating work to select workspaces you own; unallocated opportunities are not assigned to you by this filter. Use Scope clarification for incomplete selected discovery, Discovery complete for scope ready to review for manual costing, or Legacy manual basis for estimates without a recorded E2 questionnaire. Recently changed orders opportunity/discovery changes; Customer sorts by canonical customer name. Filters live in the URL and survive Reload and Back/Forward.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: Opening a record has no business effect. Complete discovery must still be deliberately adopted by the existing costing service. A changed discovery revision never silently changes a saved estimate. Draft quotation preparation uses an exact saved estimate version and remains a separate action.

sections.title: Statuses, warnings and save state
paragraphs: Discovery not started means no estimating workspace. Scope clarification means the selected discovery is Incomplete. Discovery complete describes scope only. Legacy manual basis preserves pre-questionnaire estimates. Not allocated is distinct from Sales ownership. No readable saved estimate does not mean zero cost. Intake acceptance, allocation/return commands and priority policy are Not configured. A post-Won Sales handover-due reference is an obligation, not receiving acceptance.

sections.title: Worked examples
paragraphs: Synthetic example: an open Northbank brief with no discovery appears as Discovery not started and Not allocated. Saving discovery establishes its own owner and selected option. A Complete discovery still has no estimate until manual costing is deliberately adopted. If discovery later changes, the saved estimate link continues to show its original costed revision.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: The view refreshes on focus and periodically. Loading, failed reads and denied access are distinct from an empty queue. A failed refresh clears rows and offers Try loading again. Revoked source access removes protected rows/actions. The view is bounded to 100 search/owner-matching candidates before readiness filtering; narrow search for older records. Downstream saves retain their existing expected-version and original-operation recovery; resolve an uncertain original save in its record before retrying.

sections.title: Mobile, keyboard and offline use
paragraphs: Filters stack at phone widths. Use labelled controls and Apply filters with keyboard or touch; every record link remains reachable. Browser Back/Forward restores URL filters. The global information icon opens the page guide and returns focus when closed. This page is online only and stores no business draft locally.

sections.title: Related guidance and procedures
paragraphs: ES-02 owns discovery and exact manual-cost adoption. ES-08 owns governed Screen Systems runs and explicit contribution adoption. Supplier pricing and Excel import are separate programme increments. Formal commercial review, issue and conversion remain separate business boundaries.

sections.title: Guide review and feedback
paragraphs: Prepared from the native workload implementation on 24 September 2026. This is a Draft guide; owner and operational review are pending. Verification is recorded in docs/delivery/estimating-programme-handover.md. A test pass or screenshot does not grant business acceptance or indicate deployment.

sections.title: Complete the main task
paragraphs: Preparation is entered in the Preparation view, one guided section per pack section. Each section shows the frozen context the last save composed, so entries are written against exactly what will be checked and issued.
Every save creates a new immutable revision and records its own reason with the fields that changed. There is no standing reason field on the form.

Print preview opens the exact saved server preview. Browser Print instead produces a labelled workbench copy of the saved revision, even when Preparation is selected; unsaved entries are excluded. Only the exact issued document is the controlled output. The appointment link is in section 01; an earlier issue remains explicitly linked beside an unissued successor.
steps: Open the Preparation view. The contents rail lists the nine sections and flags any that need attention.
Read the linked context for a section. Section 01 shows it in place; the others keep it behind View source details.
Complete the entry for each section. All nine are required, 1 to 6000 characters; a remaining-character count appears from 5,500.
In section 05 select the relevant service history, or explain in the note why none applies.
In section 06 select the exact document versions the crew works from. At least one is required; an unavailable source cannot be selected.
Choose Save preparation. The dialog lists every changed field and asks for the reason recorded with this save.
Confirm with Save preparation. A refusal is shown in the dialog, which stays open so the same entry can be retried unchanged.

sections.title: Purpose and outcome
paragraphs: Coordinate current review work without creating another approval authority. My reviews, All permitted, Returned to me, Handovers, Sent by me and History use real source records.

sections.title: Before you start
paragraphs: Sign in with source read permission. Assignment, reviewer eligibility and author/receiver roles come from the source. The queue does not create a Finance reviewer assignment.

sections.title: Quick start
steps: Choose the perspective that matches your work.
Filter by source and owner, then inspect the current task detail.
Use Open source to review or correct the source record; return to refresh the queue.

sections.title: Understand this page
paragraphs: Six view controls, source/owner criteria, personal saved views and a paged worklist share the My Work shell. The detail dialog shows current status/version, ownership, submission/due facts and return reason where supplied.

sections.title: Information you need
paragraphs: A missing due date says Date needed. Source slices are explicitly bounded: Service 200, Finance 500 and Engineering 200 packages; queue pages show 30 rows. Counts describe the available slice, not all business work.

sections.title: Complete the main task
steps: Inspect current source version and requested work.
For Returned to me, follow the actual correction owner and due date; an old reviewer assignment is not a current review after return.
Open the source to approve, return, correct or receive using its existing authority checks.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: Only the source command records the business decision. The coordination queue re-resolves source access/version before opening and requires refresh after a stale result.

sections.title: Statuses, warnings and save state
paragraphs: All-source failure/denial does not show zero workload. A partial source slice remains qualified. History is distinct from current actionability, and missing owner/due facts are not invented.

sections.title: Worked example
paragraphs: An Engineering return appears as one correction for its named owner, rather than a second pending review. A returned handover follows the source correction owner, reason and due date.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: Refresh a stale task before reopening. If current access is revoked, return to a permitted queue. Retain the source failure message and retry; do not complete or approve from the coordination view.

sections.title: Mobile, keyboard and offline use
paragraphs: Wrap all six perspectives and filters, stack long source/owner details at 390 and 320 CSS px, and keep Open source and dialog close reachable. Keyboard focus returns on Escape. Review decisions require the online source workflow.

paragraphs: Service reports, Finance handoffs and Engineering changes own their commands. See SH-06 implementation evidence and ADR-0041.

guides.title: Notifications and preferences
guides.content_mode: Implemented bounded synthetic workflow; draft guidance

sections.title: Purpose and outcome
paragraphs: Use Inbox, Grouped changes, Owned escalations and Preferences to coordinate current permitted Activity work. A notice is a source event; reading it is not completing the Activity.

sections.title: Before you start
paragraphs: Sign in to the synthetic application. Only current permitted Activity events for your current ownership are projected; historical recipients are not inferred.

sections.title: Quick start
steps: Open the header notification bell or My Work > Updates & preferences.
Choose a view, inspect the source and open a notice for current details.
Mark read or unread explicitly; open the source Activity to complete the actual work.

sections.title: Understand this page
paragraphs: Inbox shows individual events. Grouped changes gathers notices by source. Owned escalations shows current open owned Activities even without a notice. Preferences records email category modes, digest cadence, timezone, quiet hours and grouping.

sections.title: Information you need
paragraphs: Each notice retains event identity/time and source version. Current text and access are resolved again when opened. Inbox is a bounded slice of 200 notices, with a visible limit; owned obligations are read independently.

sections.title: Complete the main task
steps: Use explicit read/unread or archive/restore for the displayed notices. Bulk actions carry the displayed IDs and versions.
Keep active owned work visible: archive is refused while the source obligation remains open.
Edit preferences and Save preferences. Read the saved/dirty/error state before leaving.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: Opening or reading a notice never changes source status. Source completion remains in the Activity workflow. Saved preferences persist but do not schedule or send email, push or SMS.

sections.title: Statuses, warnings and save state
paragraphs: Loading, empty, partial/unavailable, denied, stale and save-error states are distinct. An unavailable source is not a zero workload. A conflicting save requires refresh/review rather than silent overwrite.

sections.title: Worked example
paragraphs: A synthetic assigned follow-up can have several retained events. Marking an event read leaves the open Activity in Owned escalations until the source work is completed.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
paragraphs: Refresh after a source/access/version change. Review the source before retrying an archive refusal. Unsaved preferences use the existing navigation warning; refresh can discard the draft.

sections.title: Mobile, keyboard and offline use
paragraphs: At 390 and 320 CSS px, wrap filters and notice actions, stack preference fields and retain readable source labels. Use Tab and Escape with the native detail dialog and return focus to its opener. Offline notification writes are not supported.

paragraphs: Source Activities own completion. See SH-03 evidence and the My Work handover; delivery-provider integration remains a separate dependency.

sections.title: Before you begin
paragraphs: Open the local PPO application or sign in to the hosted app with the authorised owner account. The catalogue examples use fixed synthetic fixtures and do not need business records. The surrounding shell still requires its normal context.

sections.title: Quick start
paragraphs: Choose Component catalogue from the design workspace. Search or select a category, then open an example. Select a state and viewport. Use the six detail views to inspect references, usage, pages and differences.

sections.title: Page tour
paragraphs: Coverage counts distinguish runnable, host and reference-only entries. Filters narrow the navigation. The selected example has state/viewport/reset controls and optional design comparison. Theme adjustment tools remain expandable below.

sections.title: Information shown
paragraphs: Each entry records owner, source export/path, exact design reference, desktop/mobile specification, states, consuming page keys, differences and review fingerprints. Unassigned review remains visible.

sections.title: Tasks
paragraphs: Use Copy example link to share an exact state and width. Reset discards local example edits. Open Used on to reach page-register local/live links and guides. Compare the same reference and application viewport. Apply durable changes through Git and a pull request.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: A browser action never updates Git or grants visual acceptance. Record an actual paired review with evidence, reviewer, date and source fingerprint; retain unresolved differences with owners.

sections.title: States and limits
paragraphs: Unknown example/state addresses are unavailable. Missing files/exports fail catalogue integrity. A changed dependency makes old review evidence stale. Reference-only entries have no fake interactive implementation.

sections.title: Synthetic example
paragraphs: Open Project Gantt, choose Programme or Undated, compare at 1440 px then 390 px, and inspect List and warning behaviour. Dates are fixed to 23 September 2026 in the catalogue. No project task is saved.

sections.title: Recovery
paragraphs: Use Reset example or reload to restore fixtures. Refresh working copy after editing sources. If a reference changes while open, refresh before comparing it again. Git history supports reverting durable changes.

sections.title: Mobile, keyboard and offline
paragraphs: The frame changes real viewport width; the host shell requires browser resizing. Use labelled controls and keyboard alternatives. Escape returns focus from overlays. Mobile emulation and illustrative offline messages do not establish device/offline acceptance.

sections.title: Resources
paragraphs: Read docs/design/development/components/README.md for the coverage and maintenance contract. Per-component rules and source links are in the catalogue. Existing UI baseline decisions remain authoritative.

sections.title: Review status
paragraphs: Draft guidance for the development catalogue. Individual visual alignment, physical-device review and operational acceptance remain separate.

guides.title: Estimating Intake
guides.content_mode: Native synthetic application; business acceptance pending

sections.title: Purpose and outcome
paragraphs: Save a Sales brief, submit an exact frozen revision and record an independent Estimating receiving decision.

sections.title: Before you start
paragraphs: The current deal owner needs opportunity edit access. The chosen receiver needs estimating.edit and source visibility. Prepare an open, owned and dated Activity linked to the Opportunity.

sections.title: Quick start
steps: Confirm your Estimating identity and source visibility.
Choose a submitted brief and open its linked record.
Review frozen evidence and clarification, then record an explicit receiving decision.

sections.title: Understand this page
paragraphs: This receiving queue shows only submitted briefs. Open the linked handover record to review its exact revision, source changes and outstanding clarification. Draft preparation is available from the Sales preparation link.
Sales preparation worklist: select a permitted deal and create its draft.
Brief: problem/outcome, included scope, exclusions, assumptions, unknowns, date, locations/equipment and exact evidence.
Review: Submit, Clarify, Answer, Resolve, Return and Accept remain separate.
History and comparison: source basis and immutable revisions. Estimating Intake shows submitted briefs.

sections.title: Information you need
paragraphs: Save is not Submit. Submission freezes content. Accepted for estimating is not estimate or quotation approval. A later draft never replaces the previous submitted basis. Evidence identifies its native source and exact revision.

sections.title: Complete the main task
steps: Choose the Opportunity and create a handover draft.
Complete the brief, date basis, next Activity and receiving owner; Save.
Read readiness and Submit the exact revision.
The receiver opens Estimating Intake and asks for clarification when needed.
Sales answers; the reviewer resolves before Accept, or returns with a reason and owned follow-up.
After return or acceptance, deliberately create and submit a successor; earlier evidence remains.

sections.title: Completion and handover
paragraphs: Acceptance records receiving evidence only. It does not create or approve an Estimate. The latest submitted revision remains the Intake basis while a successor is a draft.

sections.title: Statuses, warnings and save state
paragraphs: Loading is a pending read; a failed read is not an empty result. Complete/partial source projections retain their own observation times. Draft, Submitted, Clarification requested/answered, Returned and Accepted have distinct meanings. Aftercare Open, Review completed and Closed are separate.
